test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The given diagram shows the number of students who know different languages (Hindi, English and German).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e57450d07356a18992ef09a3c6c624771bc3f79b9166bdcdc5fa71c34a6705cd.png] 

What is the number of students who know English and German both but do NOT know Hindi?
solution:
The shaded part represents the number of students who know English and German both but do NOT know Hindi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01ca112bc3d906e9dba32ec23d39454c5a246c8279ca5eeb2fd044fb1343f44c.png] 

The number of students who know English and German both but do NOT know Hindi = 16

Hence, ‘16’ is the correct answer.
